svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Stranica-1" id="JTLKq2FYRepafLfrCVB0"> <mxGraphModel dx="2847" dy="1073" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam dpi 150
skinparam nodesep 60
skinparam ranksep 80
hide circle
left to right direction

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor white
 BorderColor black
 ArrowColor black
 FontColor black
 FontStyle plain
 AttributeFontColor black
 StereotypeFontColor black
}

class building {
 id: Long
 name: String
 address: String
 --
}

class apartment {
 id: Long
 number: String
 floor: int
 --
}

class users {
 id: Long
 firstName: String
 lastName: String
 email: String
 password: String
 role: Uloga
 --
}

class ticket {
 id: Long
 title: String
 description: String
 status: StatusTiketa
 priority: Prioritet
 createdAt: LocalDateTime
 updatedAt: LocalDateTime
 --
}

class comment {
 id: Long
 message: String
 createdAt: LocalDateTime
 --
}

class ticket_history {
 id: Long
 oldStatus: StatusTiketa
 newStatus: StatusTiketa
 changedAt: LocalDateTime
 --
}

enum Uloga <<enumeration>> {
 TENANT
 MANAGER
 TECHNICIAN
}

enum StatusTiketa <<enumeration>> {
 OPEN
 ASSIGNED
 IN_PROGRESS
 COMPLETED
 CLOSED
}

enum Prioritet <<enumeration>> {
 LOW
 MEDIUM
 HIGH
 URGENT
}

building \"1\" -- \"0..*\" apartment
users \"0..1\" -left- \"1..*\" apartment : tenant
ticket \"1\" -- \"0..*\" comment
ticket \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" ticket_history

apartment \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ticket
users \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ticket
users \"1\" -- \"0..*\" comment
users \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ticket_history

users ..> Uloga : uses
ticket ..> StatusTiketa : uses
ticket ..> Prioritet : uses
ticket_history ..> StatusTiketa : uses

@enduml
",
